independent_native_validation.readonly_pairs_explanation: Eight cases each compiled as ordinary native copy and macro transfer!: readonly target; target local alias; pointer source; nested slice source; map-element source; scalar source; array-of-scalars source; scalar source in deferred copy. Native and macro results agree in every pair. First five cases reject; last three accept.
independent_native_validation.runtime: Real CLI generated Go followed by go run -race passed: independent writable copy of readonly scalars and value arrays; defer operand evaluation and retained source/destination slice headers while bindings change; defer observes source content mutation at return; dst?/src? four success/failure combinations preserve order and suppress writes; caller-local copy shadow; ordinary pointer and nested slice copies preserve sharing.

persistent_test_assessment: Unit/acceptance coverage matches the contract, including definition/caller shadow distinctions, crossed file imports, actual native errors, repetition multiplicity, nearest explicit closure frame, LF/CRLF, deterministic Go/maps and no deep copy. Acceptance uses only synthetic-argument cases for generated/unmapped assertions; arity, ellipsis and binding errors require precise template origin and macro stack. Existing refs failures retain explicitly labelled intermediate coordinates.
qa_assessment: Six positive fixtures, eight frontend binding/readonly rejects and five native type rejects are separated. Frontend rejects require CLI/WASM diagnostic parity and error recovery. Native type rejects require identical generated Go followed by actual native go build rejection; reported output explicitly limits WASM to transpilation parity. No claim that browser execution performs final Go typechecking.
